$note: Permission rules earlier WorkOS releases shipped and this one no longer does. Over an existing settings.json, InstallSettings lists the ones present under permissionRulesToRetire in its dry run and removes them only on --apply, so the developer sees and approves the removal. Only exact matches are removed. Never list a rule settings.system.json still ships.
